task.title: Make task ID a click target for copy to clipboard
task.description:
Users need an easy way to copy a task ID from the web UI. Currently requires clicking a title to go to the task view, then selecting+copying the ID text.
Update the task board card view so that clicking the shortened ID automatically copies the full ID to the user's clipboard. The ID should still be part of the drag target, but a single click vs. a drag action should trigger the clipboard action.
In the single /task/<id> view, the ID is just text, no drag target, so make the ID simply clickable to copy to clipboard.
